summary.text: Rob Ruszkowski is an independent candidate for Georgia's 14th Congressional District and a certified write-in candidate: his name is on the Georgia Secretary of State's list of certified write-in candidates for U.S. House District 14 and is not printed on the ballot. He founded Hi-Tech Paging Inc. in Atlanta in 1991.

paragraphs.text: Born in Plainview, New York; graduated from Plainview Old Bethpage High School.
Earned a bachelor's degree in finance from Hofstra University in 1988.
Has worked as an entrepreneur and an outreach coordinator. In his Ballotpedia survey, says he founded Hi-Tech Paging Inc. in Atlanta in 1991 and grew it to five locations in Gwinnett County.
Says he cared for his parents during their final years (2005 to 2018) and describes himself as a member of the Gaia Knights Movement.
Ran in the March 10, 2026 special election for this seat as an independent and is a write-in candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election, according to Ballotpedia.
